description: Rights of Way - Footpaths is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cheshire West and Chester Council. Public Footpaths, a category of Public Rights of Way. The precise legal line of a right of way can only be determined by reference to the Definitive Map (1:10560 scale). Coverage: Cheshire West and Chester Council. The portal files it under the publisher Cheshire West and Chester Council. Its tags are Footpaths, Transport networks, cheshire west and chester council, rights of way. The portal shows 2023-09-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
